content.text:
I copied `inbox/2025-12.csv` into `data/` and committed it as `50f975f 2025-12: add rows`, using the month-first message format your import log expects.

`scripts/check.sh` passed before the commit. It checks that every row has the same number of fields as the header, across all of `data/2025-*.csv`, including the new file. The year it checks is set in `scripts/check.conf` (`year=2025`), so that setting will need updating when 2026 files arrive.

I copied the file rather than moving it, so `inbox/2025-12.csv` is still there.
